_meta.notes: Orderable MT29F4G01ABAFDWB-IT:F. The other PDFs in this folder are a Micron product page and a proxy datasheet for a different die (MT29F4G01AAADD, BGA) — not the pinout source. I/O abs max = VCC abs max (-0.6..4.6 V).

pins.name: CS#
pins.note: Chip select, active low; a falling edge is required after power-up before the first command

pins.name: WP#/IO2
pins.note: Write protect (input in x1/x2) / IO2 in x4; must not be driven by the host during x4 READ

pins.name: SCK
pins.note: Serial clock; hold at VCC or GND (mode 3/0) while CS# is high

pins.name: HOLD#/IO3
pins.note: HOLD disabled by default (standard PNs); IO3 in x4; must not be driven by the host during x4 READ

pins.name: VCC
pins.note: 2.7-3.6 V (3.3 V typ), Table 16; abs max 4.6 V, Table 15
